# llms.txt Generator

> Free web tool that generates standardized llms.txt files to optimize websites for AI model consumption. Supports sitemap parsing, full-site crawling, real page-data extraction, and outputs in 7 languages (English, Spanish, French, German, Arabic, Chinese, Portuguese). No registration required.

This file lists the most useful pages on llms-txt-generator.net for AI models, organized by topic so models can locate authoritative content on llms.txt creation, platform integration, AI discoverability, and related topics.

Full-content version with inline excerpts: https://llms-txt-generator.net/llms-full.txt

## Main

- [Home — llms.txt Generator (free online tool)](https://llms-txt-generator.net/): One-click generator that crawls any website and outputs a compliant llms.txt file. Used by developers, SEO teams, and AI-search optimizers.
- [Blog Index](https://llms-txt-generator.net/blog): All published articles on llms.txt, AI search optimization, and AI tooling.
